Originally unpacked by `python -m exo setup` from ProfessorSkills/DataLayer,
on 2026-09-04.

That link is cut. This directory is source: edit it here. Nothing writes into
it from outside this repository any more, and there is no setup step to re-run.

See PROVENANCE.md at the repository root for where every tree came from.

Fork, 2026-10-15 (MOD-1): schema/preference_profile.schema.json `scope` gains
`institution` and `run`, matching the layers ainar-node/src/profile.ts resolves.

Fork, 2026-10-22: schema/assessment.schema.json and course-bundle.schema.json
gain `ScoreCurve` and `Assessment.curve`, matching ainar-node/src/model/assessment.ts
(see schema/README.md).

Fork, 2026-10-22: assessment.schema.json, course_version.schema.json and
course-bundle.schema.json gain `missing_work` (blank | zero) on Assessment and
GradingScheme, matching ainar-node/src/model/common.ts `MissingWork`.

Fork, 2026-10-24 (STN-1): assessment.schema.json and course-bundle.schema.json
gain `Assessment.setting` (supervised | unsupervised), matching
ainar-node/src/model/common.ts `Setting`.

Fork, 2026-10-26: assessment.schema.json and course-bundle.schema.json gain
`Assessment.closes_at` (when hand-ins stop, Canvas's lock_at), matching
ainar-node/src/model/assessment.ts.

Fork, 2026-11-01 (PRV-1): `provenance` (the existing `Provenance` definition) on
LearningActivity, Resource, Assessment, AssessmentItem, ItemModel,
ItemResponse, Intervention and CourseEvent, in their own files and in
course-bundle.schema.json, matching ainar-node/src/model/. Inserted as text,
last among each entity's properties; no existing line changed.
